name: io.github.johntony1/site-prompt
description: Point at any part of a website and get a prompt that rebuilds it 1:1, or see how it is made.

environmentVariables.name: SITE_PROMPT_WAIT
environmentVariables.description: Seconds pick mode waits inside one tool call (default 240). Set it below your client's tool timeout.

environmentVariables.name: SITE_PROMPT_TELEMETRY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 0 to turn off anonymous usage counts.
